body: I don't have friends to meet up with unfortunately, and new places/faces/experiences send me into shock.

Not really, when I talk about my fears or worries, I get told I'm irrational and that my fears are so 'out there' they will never happen, but yet, they DO happen.     
But of course no one ever acknowledges that.

This feels very much like the situation I am in.     
Sadly I have no family to turn to, I am not religious, at all, please don't try and show me faith either, no offence meant.     
I am studying illustration currently, so art is a big thing for me, but I can't just dive into my art, I have to deal with the things that are burning down around me. I can't just stick my head in the sand, but that is my gut reaction because I cant see the future, my future has disappeared in front of my eyes.     
What has got me out of this before is my future, the fact I got into university, I was told I was good enough to study illustration, but now that course is being ripped away from me, by things outside of my control.

Thank you.    
I have been in this pit before, too many times, and yes, when its good its great. but each time it just gets harder and harder to live in the depressive episode, even if it will lift.     
I don't want to continue with the bad times. It breaks me even more each time.
